title: All Who Believe and Are Baptized
alsoKnownAs: He That Believes and Is Baptized
description: All Who Believe and Are Baptized in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 2 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Hansen Kingo, first published in 1689. The English translation is by George Alfred Taylor Rygh (1909). The tune, ES IST DAS HEIL UNS KOMMEN HER, is from Etlich Christlich Lider, Wittenberg, 1524. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: All who be-lieve and are bap-tized shall see the Lord's sal-va_-tion; bap-tized in-to the death of Christ, they are a new cre-a_-tion. through Christ's re-demp-tion they shall stand a-mong the glor-ious heav'n-ly band of ev-ery tribe and na_-tion.

lines: All who believe and are baptized
baptized into the death of Christ,
through Christ's redemption they shall stand
With one accord, O God, we pray:
Grant us to grow in grace each day
that by this sacrament we may
